concept_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE production-ready full-bleed 16:9 background illustration for the opening visual-novel scene of the Japanese 2D anime game ALGO: Refrain of Light. Create a completely NEW setting that unmistakably reads as INSIDE A SMARTPHONE'S SOCIAL-MEDIA TIMELINE, where an AI is waking up. NOT a building. The old art looked like an arbitrary empty futuristic hallway, which was wrong. The setting is the interior visual layers of an SNS app called Y, not outer space and not the real world.
Scene: an intimate, gently luminous stream of overlapping social-media posts viewed with shallow cinematic depth, like paper-thin panes of a phone app separating into layers. In the LEFT and RIGHT thirds, show 3-4 distinct large semi-transparent ivory/graphite post panels at oblique angles, with unmistakable round profile placeholders, a few short horizontal message strokes, small reply speech-bubble, repost arrow and pink heart icons arranged along the foot of each post. Quiet inactive panels recede into the far distance. Fine cyan reply threads connect some panels; one pale mint connection gently leads toward the otherwise empty center. Small warm pale-gold fragments of erased text drift near the lower edges only, as delicate rectangular strokes, not confetti. A narrow cropped strip of flat phone-interface navigation along the far left hints at home, messages, and drafts. These elements must look like familiar social media enlarged into a world, not control-room monitors or server racks. No walls, floor tiles, pillars, architecture, skyline, clouds, windows, horizon or physical room.
Composition: landscape 16:9, ideally 1536x864 or 2048x1152. Keep center 36-64 percent of width and top 10-72 percent of height quiet, low-detail and medium-dark charcoal teal to silhouette an existing white-haired character sprite which the game will overlay; DO NOT paint any person. Larger recognizable post panels stay at sides and upper corners. Keep bottom 24 percent low-contrast for the game's dialogue bar. An airy but bounded screen-space composition, attractive even with its center covered. Not an actual flat dashboard screenshot; an anime narrative background with crisp illustrated contours and painterly cel-shaded glass depth.
Style: delicate clean contemporary Japanese anime game background illustration, controlled 2D painted values, clear readable object silhouettes, elegant restrained lighting, no photorealism, no 3D render. Palette balanced neutral charcoal, pearl gray, soft cyan and sage green, sparing rose hearts and warm cream message strokes; no purple-heavy or blue-heavy wash. The scene should feel private, tentative and newly connected, appropriate to first contact with an AI. Keep posts visually clear, not obscured by blur or gloom.
Text: no words, no readable prose, no fake Japanese, no branding or watermark; at most ONE small literal Y on the navigation strip. No characters, humanoids, faces, robots, weapons, magic circles, bloom orbs, glowing sphere, matrix code rain, sci-fi hallways, ruins, fantasy castle. Single image only, no collage or panels.

outputs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied SNS-world illustration. We are separating this EXACT illustration into parallax animation layers for a game. Produce only the OPAQUE DISTANT BACKGROUND / CLEAN PLATE, preserving the original full 16:9 canvas, viewpoint, palette and delicate 2D illustrated finish. Remove the FOUR large nearest ivory post panels: two at left and two at right, including their large thumbnail photographs, round profile images, reply/repost/heart icons and bright outlines. Remove the cyan foreground connecting wires and floating gold/white foreground fragments as those will be animated separately in code. Seamlessly reconstruct the darker distant background under every removed object, leaving small dim receding social-feed panels and soft depth as in the original. Retain the far-left dark navigation rail with its single Y and home/search/message/compose icons, in exactly the same place. The distant panels may be recognizable as small dim SNS posts, but there must be NO large bright foreground cards left and NO bright connecting lines. The calm dark open middle and the bottom safe area remain calm. There are NO walls, pillars, corridors, glass buildings, actual physical city, no people, no text other than that one Y. The output is one full-screen background, no transparency and no collage. Carefully fill behind removed cards; this layer will be visible when the foreground cards move.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: supplied SNS-world illustration. Extract ONLY the FOUR LARGE NEAREST IVORY SOCIAL-MEDIA POST CARDS into a game animation layer with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Preserve their original perspective, positions, size, full original landscape 16:9 canvas, contents and thin clean edges. The two LEFT foreground posts show a sunlit leafy-wall picture at upper left and a resting cat picture below. The two RIGHT foreground posts show a sky-and-leaves picture at upper right and a coffee-by-window picture below. Retain each of those four cards' avatar circles, message strokes, thumbnail and small reply/repost/heart icon row. Preserve their exact original locations relative to the whole 16:9 canvas; do not recenter individual cards. The center between the left and right groups must be completely transparent. The leftmost navigation rail, ALL distant and medium-distance posts (including city, ocean, flowers), ALL scenery, all connector lines, glowing specks and particles must be removed to true transparency. Nothing remains except those four foreground cards, with no shadows outside their silhouettes. Each card's interior should be almost opaque pearly glass with the same drawn details; clean antialiased alpha only at silhouette edges. No checkerboard painted in, no gray matte, no vignette, no added objects. Do not invent a fifth card or enlarge the existing ones. Output one full-canvas RGBA PNG preserving the same size/aspect and coordinates, ready to composite over the separate clean background.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied transparent FOUR-CARD parallax layer from the anime game ALGO: Refrain of Light. Create the INACTIVE / AI FIRST-CONTACT variant. Preserve the EXACT same 16:9 canvas size and the exact perspective, silhouette, position and size of all four cards. Preserve REAL transparent alpha everywhere outside those four card silhouettes, including the entire middle and margins. Clean away any stray white extraction pixels around edges so the four silhouettes are smooth and antialiased.
Change only the interior of the four cards: remove ALL photographs from rectangular thumbnails and avatars, replacing the large thumbnail areas with empty smoked-gray glass with a very subtle mint reflection. Avatars become simple neutral round placeholders. Keep the short message placeholder strokes and tiny reply/repost/heart row, but make the heart unfilled gray. Change the ivory card surface to restrained medium-dark translucent-looking charcoal-gray (keep the interiors opaque enough to avoid showing the old photos through), with a fine pale cyan rim. The top-left card should read as an unfilled draft, the bottom-left a blank reply, the right two as sleeping feed posts, through tiny simple compose/message icons only. NO readable text, names, numbers, no Y or MINA. No new panels, no scenery, no connector wires, no particles, no colored background or painted checkerboard. This is an animation layer to place above another image. Same delicate 2D illustrated finish, not a 3D UI mockup. Output one RGBA PNG.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied transparent four-card layer. Create the ERASED / UNSENT DRAFTS variant for a quiet emotional scene of the anime game ALGO: Refrain of Light. Preserve EXACT same full 16:9 canvas, all four panels' positions, perspective, size and outer silhouettes, and genuine transparent RGBA outside them. The center stays completely transparent. Keep clean antialiased edges with no stray white residue.
Replace the four empty thumbnail areas with visual traces of unsent messages: only 3-5 short thin pale-gold handwritten-like horizontal strokes per panel, with some strokes interrupted halfway or softly fading away, and a tiny insertion caret at the right end of ONE surviving stroke. These are illegible fragments, NO actual words, NO Japanese, NO numerals. Under those traces retain a subtle inset outline suggesting an unsent message entry field; the send arrow is very faint and inactive. The top-left panel has the clearest remaining traces, the others are almost empty. Avatars remain hollow anonymous circles; reaction icons should nearly disappear. Change cool cyan edge accents to desaturated warm gray and pale champagne, with one very faint rose edge, maintaining charcoal translucent-glass illustrated surfaces. No photographs, no damage cracks, no torn paper, no person, no sky, no architecture, no wires or floating particles. All marks must stay INSIDE the four existing panels. Do not add anything outside them. Restrained 2D anime painted finish. Output only one transparent four-panel parallax layer.
